grades.reason: Describes the Zihintpause PAUSE hint, which is encoded in the FENCE opcode. It says nothing about FENCE.I or about synchronizing instruction fetch after code modification.
Gives an I/O ordering example using FENCE W,O. It does not cover FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization.
Covers commit conditions for normal fences and fence.tso in the operational memory model. It does not cover FENCE.I or the need for it after writing executable code.
Covers acquire/release orderings with FENCE and AMO annotations under RVWMO. It does not cover FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization.
